# Project Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

source("https://inkaverse.com/setup.r")

library(googlesheets4)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Diseño experimental

```{r}
# Enlace original de Tarpuy
url <- paste0(
  "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/",
  "16sTtIytBxlQXFc19gnf_gDEXDXYpsdFdzu52PbPXc5E/edit"
)

# Leer el diseño directamente desde Google Sheets
fb <- googlesheets4::read_sheet(
  url,
  sheet = "fb"
)

# Verificar que existan las columnas necesarias
columnas <- c(
  "plots", "rows", "cols", "block",
  "ntreat", "variedad", "dosis"
)

stopifnot(all(columnas %in% names(fb)))

# Mostrar los registros originales
fb %>%
  dplyr::select(
    plots, block, ntreat,
    variedad, dosis
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    caption = "Libro de campo original de Tarpuy"
  )
```

## Tratamientos experimentales

```{r}
# Tabla de tratamientos según Tarpuy
tratamientos <- tibble::tibble(
  ntreat = 1:4,
  tratamiento = paste0("T", 1:4),
  variedad = c(
    "INIA 419 San Francisco",
    "INIA 433 K'anchareq",
    "INIA 419 San Francisco",
    "INIA 433 K'anchareq"
  ),
  dosis = c(0, 0, 100, 100)
)

tratamientos %>%
  knitr::kable(
    caption = "Tratamientos del DBCA factorial 2 x 2"
  )
```

## Croquis experimental

```{r}
#| label: croquis-experimental
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 7

# Utilizar exclusivamente el diseño de Tarpuy
croquis <- fb %>%
  mutate(
    plots = as.character(plots),
    rows = as.integer(rows),
    cols = as.integer(cols),
    ntreat = as.integer(ntreat),
    dosis = as.numeric(dosis),
    tratamiento = factor(
      paste0("T", ntreat),
      levels = paste0("T", 1:4)
    ),
    etiqueta = paste0(
      plots, "\n",
      tratamiento
    )
  )

# Comprobar el diseño experimental
stopifnot(nrow(croquis) == 16)

stopifnot(
  all(
    table(croquis$rows, croquis$tratamiento) == 1
  )
)

# Generar el croquis original desde Google Sheets
ggplot(
  croquis,
  aes(
    x = cols,
    y = -rows,
    fill = tratamiento
  )
) +
  geom_tile(
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = etiqueta),
    size = 4,
    color = "black",
    lineheight = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "T1" = "#81C784",
      "T2" = "#F4C55E",
      "T3" = "#52A58E",
      "T4" = "#FF6675"
    ),
    name = "Tratamientos"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:4,
    limits = c(0.5, 4.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = -4:-1,
    labels = 4:1,
    limits = c(-4.5, -0.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(
    title = "Croquis experimental del trigo",
    subtitle = "DBCA factorial 2 x 2 - 4 bloques y 16 maceteros",
    x = "Columnas",
    y = "Bloques"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.direction = "horizontal"
  )
```

# Etiquetas

## Configuración de fuentes

```{r}
font <- c(
  "Permanent Marker",
  "Tillana",
  "Courgette"
)

huito_fonts(font)
```

## Preparación de etiquetas

```{r}
# Utilizar el mismo libro de campo original
# No generar nuevos tratamientos ni aleatorización

fb <- fb %>%
  mutate(
    variedad_lab = gsub(
      "'",
      "",
      as.character(variedad),
      fixed = TRUE
    ),
    dosis_lab = paste0(
      dosis,
      " g/macetero"
    )
  )

# Identificador de la pestaña fb
gid_fb <- "1379194196"

# QR dirigido a la fila original de cada macetero
fb$qrcode <- paste0(
  url,
  "#gid=", gid_fb,
  "&range=A",
  seq_len(nrow(fb)) + 1
)

# Comprobar cantidad de etiquetas
stopifnot(nrow(fb) == 16)
```

## Diseño de las etiquetas

```{r}
label <- fb %>%
  label_layout(
    size = c(5.2, 10),
    border_color = "#5C0000",
    border_width = 1.5
  ) %>%
  include_image(
    value = "https://inkaverse.com/img/inkaverse.png",
    size = c(1.3, 1.5),
    position = c(0.8, 9.1)
  ) %>%
  include_text(
    value = "plots",
    position = c(4.2, 9.1),
    size = 20,
    color = "black",
    fontface = "bold",
    font = font[1]
  ) %>%
  include_image(
    value = "https://huito.inkaverse.com/img/scale.pdf",
    size = c(5, 1),
    position = c(2.6, 7.7)
  ) %>%
  include_barcode(
    value = "qrcode",
    size = c(5, 5),
    position = c(2.6, 4.7)
  ) %>%
  include_text(
    value = "variedad_lab",
    position = c(2.6, 2.1),
    size = 6.5,
    prefix = "Variedad: ",
    color = "blue",
    font = font[2],
    fontface = "bold"
  ) %>%
  include_text(
    value = "dosis_lab",
    position = c(2.6, 1.5),
    size = 9,
    prefix = "Humus: ",
    color = "red",
    font = font[2],
    fontface = "bold"
  ) %>%
  include_image(
    value = "https://huito.inkaverse.com/img/scale.pdf",
    size = c(5, 1),
    position = c(2.6, 0.6)
  )

# Vista previa
label %>%
  label_print(mode = "preview")
```

## Exportar etiquetas en PDF

```{r}
label %>%
  label_print(
    mode = "complete",
    filename = "vertical-DBCA-2"
  )
```
